claim: Engine detectors must read the snapshot class that auto passes: detect on .memory, and a 128K engine's is_ must also read skoolkit's memory.banks.

evidence.text: Detector read .banks, which only the converter's snapshot class has, so auto's skoolkit snapshot never matched; detect on .memory.
Same first-draft detector fault: .banks never matched auto's skoolkit snapshot.
